text:
sophia_partnerships: Quick sync  vendor asked for precise marketplace freeze rules and an embargo-aware rollout for H100/H200/B200/MI300/Gaudi. We also have an edge-case: H200 BIOS might change CPU P-state behavior that affects perf counters. Need infra + SI triage.

rajesh_infra: Noted. Short status: H100 images are green. H200 BIOS candidate landed in partner CI but shows a 4-8% delta on 8k sequences in our perf harness. B200 fan v6 looks stable. MI300 long-context OOM on quant path still unresolved. Gaudi driver backport ready but kernel mismatch on some hosts.

megan_si: SI availability this week is Wed/Thu AM. We need final artifacts (BIOS, driver packages, kernel patches) 48h before slot. Important: if BIOS alters P-state behavior, our perf counters will need a calibration step; that adds a half-day to the cert.

diego_vendor_pm: We're pushing h200-bios-candidate-v4 to the partner bucket in the next 6h: s3://partners/redwood/h200/2799999999/h200-bios-v4.bin sha256: d4f5e6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e. Note: this BIOS fixes a thermal runaway but changes the turbo floor on one SKU. No special press embargo beyond 48h.

rajesh_infra: Thanks. We'll run a focused 4-hour 8k sequence perf sweep tonight against h200-bios-candidate-v4 and post perf_diff.csv. If perf delta >5% we flag as "performance-impacting" and require vendor rollback or tuning.

megan_si: We can accept the half-day calibration if diego confirms the change is deterministic. Otherwise we have to push H200 validation to next week.

ella_comms: From comms: do not include H200 in marketplace copy unless SI cert is green and vendor embargo observed. If H200 is delayed we should publish H100+B200 with a short note: "Other devices validating; updates forthcoming."

sophia_partnerships: Propose contingency options: (A) If H200 perf delta <=5% and SI calibrates, include H200 in initial GA with technical note; (B) If >5% or non-deterministic, ship H100+B200 and mark H200/MI300/Gaudi as "validating". Which teams can execute A quickly?

rajesh_infra: I'll run the 8k sweep 22:00-02:00 UTC. Image tag: h200-bios-v4-sweep-2799999999. Deploy bot will publish smoke results. If delta is small I'll also run a 24h endurance to validate stability.

deploy-bot: image h200-bios-v4-sweep-2799999999 pushed to staging at 2026-03-23T22:05:00Z. Smoke tests queued.

diego_vendor_pm: We'll also drop a debug-enabled MI300 nightly with additional logs for the quantized path: s3://partners/redwood/mi300/2799999999/mi300-quant-debug.tar.gz sha256: e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5. Vendor note: MI300 fix ETA ~72h if logs reproduce.

megan_si: SI can run connector + perf calibration Thu 07:00 UTC if artifacts are present Wed EOD. Otherwise we certify H100+B200 and schedule H200 follow-up.

ella_comms: Draft marketplace blurb (internal): "Initial GA: H100 (certified) and B200 (certified). H200, MI300, and Gaudi are under validation; they will be added following partner-driven SI certification and completion of vendor embargo windows." Holding until SI green.

sophia_partnerships: Action items (canonical): 1) diego -> confirm S3 URIs + shas (done), 2) rajesh -> post perf_diff.csv + endurance summary after runs, 3) megan -> confirm calibration time estimate if BIOS changes P-states, 4) ella -> hold comms copy until SI + 48h embargo. Keep artifact URIs and hashes in this thread only.

rajesh_infra: Perf sweep started. Posting initial diff in ~3.5h. If we need to flag as "performance-impacting": I'll include a short runbook with recommended runtime knobs to mitigate.

megan_si: Noted. If perf-impacting but deterministic, we can still certify with calibration and a "performance note" in the portal. That avoids blocking marketplace but increases the risk of customer confusion; comms will need to be explicit.

ella_comms: If we go that route, include the note: "H200 certified with recommended runtime profile; see runtime notes for best-effort thermal settings." I will prep the copy but not publish.

sophia_partnerships: Thanks all. Please paste any embargo exceptions or partner PR windows here immediately. Ill escalate to partners if we need a rollback. :triage_flag:
